title: Nicene
summary: NICENE, adjective Pertaining to Nice, a town of Asia Minor. The nicene creed, was a summary of Christian faith composed by the council of Nice against Arianism, adjective D. 325, altered and confirmed

inlines.v: NICENE, adjective Pertaining to Nice, a town of Asia Minor. The nicene creed, was a summary of Christian faith composed by the council of Nice against Arianism, adjective D. 325, altered and confirmed by the council of Constantinople, adjective D. 381.
